thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated egress latency and TCP resets observed from us-west-2a affecting inference endpoints (p50 -> p95 token latency jump). Autoscaling and healthchecks reporting sporadic failures.
Alex P: seeing a ~12% increase in 5xx rate for inference route /v1/generate from us-west-2a clients. Latency graphs look like a stair-step starting ~2m ago.
Priya S: confirmed. DNS lookups to resolver in us-west-2a show timeouts. Dig output intermittently returns SERVFAIL. Could be resolver or path.
Dan L: running quick checks from a host in the AZ:
```
# from us-west-2a test host
$ dig +short +time=2 api.internal.redwood.svc
; <no output sometimes>
$ curl -v http://10.12.34.56:8000/health
* Connected to 10.12.34.56 (10.12.34.56) port 8000 (#0)
* TCP connection reset by peer
```
Jen R: i'm primary oncall, taking lead. Paging network oncall and infra. Samir, can you triage ENI/egress queues? @carla are you available for resolver checks?
Samir K: looking now. ENI metrics show TX drops and RX errors on a subset of host NICs. AWS metrics for ENI TXQueueLength spiked. Might be host-level driver backpressure.
Carla M: checking VPC resolver logs — we see sporadic 502s from the resolver appliance and high latencies to 169.254.169.254 for metadata. Could be upstream path to NAT/egress.
Alex P: impact assessment: ~10-15% of inference requests from us-west-2a failing fast; downstream clients seeing increased retries. Regional traffic is still healthy in other AZs. No customer-facing rate limit changes yet.
Priya S: immediate mitigation plan:
- exclude us-west-2a from routing for inference fleet (steer traffic to other AZs/regions)
- enable canary fallback to eu-west-1 for long-running jobs
- spin extra warm instances in us-west-2b/c and eu-west-1 for capacity
- contact cloud provider to open support ticket for possible NIC/host issue
Jen R: executing routing change now: `redwoodctl traffic steer --exclude-az=us-west-2a --reason="egress-latency"`
```
$ redwoodctl traffic steer --exclude-az=us-west-2a --timeout=30m --reason="egress-latency"
Steering requests submitted. Expect propagation in ~30s.
```
Dan L: traffic shift in progress. Token latency p95 for affected route dropping back toward normal as we drain us-west-2a. 5xx rate declining.
Samir K: opened AWS support case (case 123456789) for suspected ENI driver backpressure on specific host family. Also flagged instance SIGTERM/oom logs — not seeing OOMs but kernel tx-sched warnings present.
Carla M: temporary DNS workaround applied: increased resolver pool and disabled local resolver caching on a subset to avoid thundering retries. This should reduce SERVFAILs while we wait on provider.
Alex P: customer impact note for comms: small subset of customers in us-west-2a seeing elevated errors and latency. Recommend internal status update and optional external note if degraded persists >1h.
Priya S: noted. Will draft status once we confirm stabilization.
Jen R: on-call handoff plan: i'll remain lead until us-west-2a is back to baseline or we have provider fix. If case escalates to infra, ping Samir and then escalate to network lead.
Samir K: collecting host IDs and ENI IDs for AWS case. Attaching kernel logs and `ethtool -S` snapshots.
Dan L: quick checklist I ran: `ss -tanp | grep :8000` (several TIME_WAIT and a few RST), `dmesg | tail` (tx sched warnings). Posting snippets in case bundle.
Priya S: reroute metrics: after steer p95 token latency for route down from 1.8s to 420ms, error rate down to 2% from 12%. Still monitoring.
Alex P: mitigation status: routing exclusion is holding. No data loss, just increased cross-AZ egress. Cost increase expected due to cross-az traffic and regional fallback.
Carla M: provider update: AWS investigating potential NIC driver regression on select hardware in us-west-2a, asked for host level diagnostics. ETA unknown.
Jen R: next actions: keep steer active, monitor for 30m, if stable begin gradual re-enable of us-west-2a with canary traffic at 1% -> 5% -> 25%.
Samir K: uploaded all logs to case and included host perf counters. Also scheduled a rolling host reboot candidate if provider advises.
Priya S: comms: draft to legal/ops for optional external status page: suggested message: "We are experiencing increased network latency in a US-West AZ affecting a subset of inference requests. We have routed traffic away from the affected AZ and are monitoring. Some customers may see increased latency. We'll update in 1 hour or when we have a provider timeline."
Alex P: :white_check_mark: agreed. If anything changes or if error rate climbs, re-open pager and escalate.
Jen R: handing ops to Samir for overnight monitoring. I'm staying on until rollback plan is validated. Thanks all.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: incident opened 6191112222, severity: SEV2, owners: Jen R (primary), Samir K (net), Carla M (dns).
